text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Elevated 502/504 spike observed at API gateway (edge tier). Start triage. Root metrics: gateway_5xx_rate up from 0.2% to 8% in last 5m. Trace sample: multiple upstream timeouts.

sarah.ng: saw the alert, I'm looking. Any correlated deploys?

mike: no recent prod deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot, looks like traffic surge/timeout to model-backend pool.

deploy-bot: No deployments to prod in last 60 minutes (commit a1b2c3).

anika: quick checks: LB healthy, edge autoscale hasn't kicked. Are we seeing connection resets from a specific AZ?

leo: checking logs -> majority of 502s show upstream read timeout  (504) from model-frontend instances in us-west-2a. Sample log snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T08:25:12Z] proxy_1 | GET /v1/generate -> upstream model-frontend-3:504 Gateway Timeout (read timeout)
request_id=req_6f7a user=svc-account
```

sarah.ng: adding correlation: Redis cache hit ratio dropped ~15% at same time. Could be cache eviction storm causing backend overload and downstream timeouts.

mike: good catch. Can we confirm KV cache eviction logs? leo, can you tail redis-exporter and model-frontend logs?

leo: tailing now. Redis reports LRU evictions spike ~08:22-08:28. model-frontend metrics show worker queue depth increasing and 95p latency jumping from 120ms to 1.8s.

anika: mitigation proposal 1) enable read-through cache bypass for non-critical routes, 2) scale model-frontend pool (add 4 instances in us-west-2), 3) increase upstream timeout at gateway from 30s -> 45s temporarily. Which do we want first?

mike: start instance scale and gateway timeout. I'll trigger scale. sarah, can you prepare a temporary routing rule to route small percentage (10%) to fallback region (us-east-1) if us-west-2 latency > 1s?

sarah.ng: will prepare canary routing. Pushing step now:
```
# temporary: route rule
match: region=us-west-2 and latency>1000
action: route->us-east-1 fallback pool (10%)
```
Applying in 30s.

deploy-bot: Autoscale request accepted: scaling model-frontend pool +4 instances in us-west-2 (scale-group model-frontend-prod). ETA ~90s.

leo: increasing gateway upstream_timeout to 45s on edge proxies in us-west-2. Command: `rbctl set gateway.timeout 45s --region us-west-2 --target edge-*`

mike: executing gateway change now.

anika: I'm flagging this as SEV2 due to customer-facing errors across multiple customers. cs-rep, any live reports?

cs-rep: we're seeing ~12% of API calls returning 502/504 for customers in NA-west. A few support tickets and PagerDuty alerts from enterprise customers. Logged in to CS dashboard and notified customer success team.

incident-bot: Incident updated: Severity set to SEV2 by mike. Incident channel created: #incident-1772009999 (private).

sarah.ng: canary routing pushed. Monitoring now.

leo: model-frontend instances scaling complete. New capacity online. Worker queue depth dropping.

mike: gateway timeout change applied. Observing backend latency stabilization. 5xx% dropping from 8% -> 3% in 2m.

anika: still seeing some tail errors from a subset of model-frontend hosts. I'm going to exclude the oldest instance image (image v20260212-rc) from rotation and drain it.

leo: draining instance model-frontend-3 and replacing with fresh image v20260301.

sarah.ng: cache warming in progress; pre-warming top prefixes using warmup job (low-priority).

mike: important: rolling mitigation checklist - scale, increase timeout, route fallback, drain bad instance, warm cache. Any rollback risk? None so far.

cs-rep: customer-notify draft: "We're investigating elevated API errors affecting some requests in US-West; mitigation in progress. Root cause appears to be cache eviction causing backend overload. We'll update in 15 minutes." Approve?

anika: approve. Send.

mike: 5xx rate now ~1.2%, still above baseline but trending down. Keep monitoring 15m window. I'll stay incident commander and will handoff to oncall in 30m unless it stabilizes.

incident-bot: Reminder: add timeline entries and tag related PRs.

leo: drained instance replaced, all replaced nodes report healthy. No more eviction spikes after cache warm. 5xx now ~0.4%.

sarah.ng: removing temporary routing after 10m stable.

mike: switching to watch mode. Handing off active incident to anika for the next on-call window. anika, you are the incident lead.

anika: ack. I'll run a follow-up postmortem and list action items: 1) tune Redis eviction policy and monitor, 2) add circuit-breaker on gateway per-backend, 3) automate fallback routing for region latency, 4) add cache-warm on scale events.

mike: no objections. Marking mitigations complete for now.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Closing notifications will be sent in 30 minutes if stable. :white_check_mark:

cs-rep: updating customers: sent initial message and followed up after mitigation. Customers acknowledged.

anika: adding follow-up owner: sarah.ng for routing automation, leo for infra tuning, mike for runbook updates.

mike: good job team. Postmortem please in /docs/incidents/ with timeline and graphs.

sarah.ng: will file postmortem once data ingested.

incident-bot: Thread archived after handoff."
